training.long: 20 km with 12–15 kg; back-to-back days every second weekend; a hill weekend mid-January
20–25 km with your full pack; a 2–3 day kit test with a cold night
Short loaded walk; final gear shakedown

prep.t: Passport valid for 6+ months; the route crosses into Lesotho
Travel insurance that covers hiking above 3,000 m and helicopter rescue
Satellite communicator for the group, with a plan for who carries it
Park permits paid; rescue register signed at the start and finish
Trip plan and check-in schedule left with someone at home
GPX loaded on phone and GPS, maps and compass practised
Boots broken in; full pack tested on a multi-day walk
Food packed by day, mouse-proof bag, two spare days
Escape passes noted for each day
Cash for Sani Top Chalet and tips
